mechanism: Echinacea may induce CYP3A4 and other hepatic enzymes, potentially reducing clindamycin levels; additionally, echinacea's immunostimulant effects may theoretically interfere with antimicrobial efficacy or alter immune response during infection treatment.
action: Monitor clinical response to clindamycin therapy; consider separating administration timing and counsel patient that herbal supplements may reduce antibiotic effectiveness; verify infection resolution.
